workbench.scenarioHelp: Protocol names only describe the scenario. Amounts are whole satoshis in msat (1 sat = 1,000 msat).
workbench.exactMsat: Enter nonnegative whole-satoshi amounts as msat, without separators.
workbench.comparisonHelp: Exact fractions within the same subject, observer and snapshot. Not ownership probabilities.
workbench.incomparable: These results cannot be compared: both must be exact and belong to the same subject, observer and snapshot.
workbench.conditionalLinks: Membership counts in feasible flow groups under the stated model. Not proof of ownership.
workbench.pickerUnavailable: File selection is available in the desktop app or connected local preview.
workbench.inputsChanged: Inputs changed. Analyze again to review the current selection.

psbt.title: Inspect a transaction before signing
psbt.help: Local inspection only. Nothing is signed or broadcast.
psbt.networkHelp: Scripts do not encode the network. Chain membership and unspentness are not verified.
psbt.validationHelp: Structural validity does not verify signatures, ownership, network or unspentness.
psbt.assistantPrompt: Inspect the currently selected local PSBT source references and explicit comparison constraints: {{selection}}. Use the PSBT tools to analyze both sources and compare when an after_token is present. If current_comparison_available is false, compute a fresh comparison; an entropy_job_id refers to its submitted historical computation. Explain missing UTXO evidence, features, changes and limitations. Do not sign or broadcast.

datasets.title: Local attribution datasets
datasets.help: Versioned source claims for exact matching. Labels are sourced claims, not proof of ownership or taint.
datasets.visibilityHelp: Public makes the claims visible to the public observer model. Nothing is uploaded.
datasets.formatHelp: Generic rows: subject, label, optional category. Preview validates the whole file.
datasets.previewChanged: Source or manifest changed. Validate a fresh preview before importing.
datasets.confirmHelp: Import binds this content hash and manifest. A replacement activates only after the full import succeeds.
datasets.queryHelp: Exact chain subject, or an exact entity label within one dataset. No match does not establish absence.
datasets.subject: Exact subject
datasets.label: Exact label
datasets.noMatch: No matching claims in this scoped lookup.
datasets.discardHelp: Removes the stored rows of this incomplete import only.
datasets.assistantDataset: Inspect local attribution dataset {{id}} using dataset tools. Explain provenance, version, visibility and limitations. Labels remain sourced claims, not ownership or taint evidence.
datasets.assistantSource: Help inspect the selected local attribution source using opaque token {{token}}. Use an on-device provider for file preview/import. Require validated content and explicit consent before importing; do not fetch external data.
